title: Searching a suffix array with no suffixes underflows n - 1
body:
`SufrSearch::search` in `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` starts with:

```rust
let n = self.len_suffixes;
if let Some(start) = self.suffix_search_first(qry, 0, n - 1, 0, 0) {
```

`n - 1` underflows when `len_suffixes` is 0. Debug builds panic. Release builds pass `usize::MAX` as `high`. It is unclear whether the builder can produce a `.sufr` file with no suffixes, since every text ends in a sentinel. A hand-made or truncated file could still reach this.

Found by reading the code. Not reproduced.
close_reason: Unreachable: the sentinel suffix is always indexed, so every file has at least one suffix, and an empty input does not build. Closed by Jack on 2026-11-03.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text: At cff9fb6 the site is `matching_ranks` (`search.rs:155-157`), which computes `n - 1` with `n = self.num_searched()`. Not run.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: The same holds on dev at 657e16d: `sufr_search.rs:102-103` computes `n - 1`, the builder always keeps the sentinel suffix and an empty input fails to build, so only a hand-made file reaches it.
